title: What's the Next Step?
description: You're given a matrix that isn't in row echelon form yet — pick the correct next move in the algorithm, in the right order.

questions.prompt: This matrix is **not yet** in row echelon form: $$\left[\begin{array}{cccc|c}1 & 3 & 2 & 1 & 10\\0 & 0 & -3 & -3 & -13\\0 & 0 & -3 & 1 & -7\\0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 9\end{array}\right]$$ What is the best next step?
choices: This column has no possible pivot, so move on to the next column
explanations: Row 4 hasn't even been swapped into the pivot position yet — you can't use it to eliminate other rows before that.
Row 4 still has a nonzero entry in this column, so a pivot IS possible here — you just need to swap it into place first, not skip the column.
Row 2's entry in this column is already 0 — scaling it by anything still leaves a 0. This doesn't fix the missing pivot.
